🚨🇺🇸 Can’t America’s military bases already keep their own lights on? Yes, which makes the Pentagon’s 90-day self-sufficiency order a warning aimed at everyone outside the fence

Fort Bragg runs its own power plant, its own water treatment and its own hospital, so a retired Green Beret who commanded there reads the new order as a message for the rest of the country:

“So hey, military bases, keep the lights on, everybody else suck it up.”

Anthony Aguilar says Marines are now drilling to protect the spots where undersea cables come ashore, because the next round after the midterms will see Washington hit Iranian power, water and bridges, and Tehran answer in kind, from cables to the grid.

He points to Moore County, North Carolina, where one man with a shotgun knocked out power and water to tens of thousands for days in 2022, as proof you don’t need a missile to reach America. 

The Vance letter, in his reading, buys a week, and the week after that is when the bill arrives.

@WeTheBrandon

🇺🇸🇸🇴 Federal agents searched Ilhan Omar’s home over paperwork her father filed... Somalilanders want to know what that father did in Hargeisa

Nur Omar Mohamed came to America as a refugee in the 1990s, and the New York Post now reports he was a full colonel in dictator Siad Barre’s army until the regime fell, the same army that leveled Hargeisa and killed tens of thousands of Isaaq civilians in what Somaliland calls its forgotten genocide.

Saeed Ibrahim, founder of the Somaliland Chronicle, says the colonel was posted to Hargeisa while the city was being shelled, and he puts the question plainly:

“Perpetrators cannot claim to be refugees at the same time alongside the same people that they brutalized.”

Nobody has shown the colonel personally took part in the killings, and he died in 2020.

Saeed’s point is narrower: when a regime collapses, its officers hide among the people they ran from, and Washington deported one Barre-era colonel last year who was found driving for Uber.

The congresswoman denies wrongdoing and calls the October 12 raid political.

Whether her father’s rank was ever disclosed on those forms is now the question the case may turn on.

@Saeed_beeldeeq @WeTheBrandon
